model.name: resnet18
model.preprocessing:
ImageClassification(
    crop_size=[224]
    resize_size=[256]
    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406]
    std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
    interpolation=InterpolationMode.BILINEAR
)

numerical_settings.note: Pageable CPU transfers; non_blocking does not promise transfer/compute overlap.

motion_descriptor_definition.mean: unweighted mean over all exported vector entries
motion_descriptor_definition.reference_direction: source<0: past; source>0: future; source==0: other
motion_descriptor_definition.retention: one fresh frozen slotted MotionDescriptor per decoded frame in a CPU list until timer stops
motion_descriptor_definition.invalid_data: raise ValueError with video/frame context; do not discard or invent vectors
motion_descriptor_definition.scope: no optical flow, physical velocity, learned motion encoder, or descriptor GPU transfer
